plan.venue_summary: Mohawk's crowd runs from art-rock and indie (Geordie Greep, Hovvdy, Kishi Bashi) to punk and noise (The Linda Lindas, Show Me the Body, Lip Critic). It's a downtown Austin room that mixes rising indie and DIY acts with heavier touring bills.

recommendations.why: Very strong taste match with fans of The Linda Lindas and Hovvdy. A rising act that hasn't played Mohawk recently. I found no recent Austin-area shows, so the date is open and unconfirmed.
recommendations.offer_email:
Hi Dehd team,

I book Mohawk in Austin (cap. ~250 indoor/outdoor mix). Our crowd turns out for acts like The Linda Lindas and Hovvdy, and Dehd's sound is a natural fit. We haven't hosted you recently and think Austin is ready for a headline night.

We'd love to offer a headline slot on your next Texas run, with Austin's Sun June as support. We can share a guarantee/door-split structure, hospitality and local promo support.

What dates are you routing through Texas? Happy to work around your holds.

Best,
[Your name], Talent Buyer, Mohawk

recommendations.why: Very strong taste match with fans of Geordie Greep and Kishi Bashi, a rising art-pop act. Touring heavily (20 recent shows found) but none near Austin and none at Mohawk.
recommendations.offer_email:

recommendations.why: Strong taste match with fans of The Linda Lindas and Show Me the Body. Not an emerging act, and it's the only gap found: they play Radio East in Austin the night before.
recommendations.routing_note: Open date Sun 15 Nov between Radio East, Austin (14 Nov) and Oklahoma City (16 Nov).
